eager.zh: 渴望的、急切的（be eager to）

ex.en: She is eager to live in Australia.
ex.zh: 她渴望住在澳洲。

ex.en: He is eager to go there.
ex.zh: 他很想去那裡。

ex.en: He is eager to please.
ex.zh: 他非常想討人喜歡。

ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
ex.zh: 每位會員每個月要繳一萬日圓。

ex.en: Each time he escaped, he returned to this region.
ex.zh: 他每次逃走，都會回到這個地區。

ex.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
ex.zh: 校長頒發畢業證書給每位畢業生。

ex.en: Each of us has a different job.
ex.zh: 我們每個人的工作都不一樣。

ex.en: After all they came to terms with each other.
ex.zh: 最後他們彼此達成了協議。

ex.en: You must not talk to each other in class.
ex.zh: 上課時不可以互相講話。

ex.en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
ex.zh: 你沒有你姐姐那麼早起。

ex.en: I went to bed early, for I was tired.
ex.zh: 我很早就上床睡覺了，因為很累。

ex.en: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
ex.zh: 如果我早點到，就能見到凱莉了。

ex.en: I have an early meeting tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天一早有個會。

ex.en: The building was built in the early 1900s.
ex.zh: 這棟建築建於1900年代初期。

ex.en: The math homework was easier than I had expected.
ex.zh: 那份數學功課比我想的簡單。

ex.en: It is easy for me to read this book.
ex.zh: 這本書對我來說很容易讀。

ex.en: I find this problem easier than I originally thought.
ex.zh: 我發現這個問題比我原本想的簡單。

easy.zh: take it easy：放輕鬆、別緊張

ex.en: Take it easy, there's no rush.
ex.zh: 放輕鬆，不用急。

ex.en: The doctor told me to take it easy.
ex.zh: 醫生叫我好好休息。

ex.en: You will soon get used to eating Japanese food.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣吃日本料理。

ex.en: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.
ex.zh: 我兩個半小時前吃了午餐。

ex.en: I like grapes, but I can't eat so many.
ex.zh: 我雖然喜歡葡萄，但吃不了那麼多。

ex.en: We usually eat out on Friday nights.
ex.zh: 我們週五晚上通常在外面吃。

ex.en: Eating out every day is expensive.
ex.zh: 每天外食很花錢。

ex.en: He wasn't earning a large salary when he retired.
ex.zh: 他退休時薪水並不高。

ex.en: He earns not more than 50 dollars a week.
ex.zh: 他一個星期賺不到五十美元。

ex.en: The more you earn, the more you spend.
ex.zh: 賺得越多，花得越多。

ex.en: She earned the respect of her team.
ex.zh: 她贏得了團隊的尊敬。

ex.en: You've earned a good rest.
ex.zh: 你應該好好休息一下了。

ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.
ex.zh: 你很容易就能看出差別。

ex.en: You should be able to read this book easily.
ex.zh: 你應該能輕鬆讀懂這本書。

ex.en: You won't be able to fool Tom so easily.
ex.zh: 你沒辦法那麼輕易騙過湯姆。

ex.en: About one third of the earth's surface is land.
ex.zh: 地球表面約有三分之一是陸地。

ex.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
ex.zh: 如今我們的人造衛星正繞著地球運轉。

ex.en: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
ex.zh: 地球的形狀像柳橙。

ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?
ex.zh: 你到底在我房間裡做什麼？

ex.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
ex.zh: 你到底為什麼把新蓋好的房子賣掉？

ex.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
ex.zh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。

ex.en: He listened with his ear to the door.
ex.zh: 他把耳朵貼在門上聽。

ear.zh: 聽力、辨音能力（have an ear for）

ex.en: She has a good ear for music.
ex.zh: 她很有音感。

ex.en: He has an ear for languages.
ex.zh: 他學語言很有天分。

ear.zh: play it by ear：見機行事、隨機應變

ex.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你得見機行事。

ex.en: We don't have a plan yet, so let's play it by ear.
ex.zh: 我們還沒有計畫，就見機行事吧。

ex.en: The sun always rises in the east.
ex.zh: 太陽總是從東方升起。

ex.en: The wind is blowing from the east.
ex.zh: 風從東邊吹來。

ex.en: Nagoya is to the east of Kyoto.
ex.zh: 名古屋在京都的東邊。

ex.en: The east coast of Taiwan is beautiful.
ex.zh: 台灣的東海岸很美。

ex.en: Our office is on the east side of the city.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在城市的東區。

ex.en: We drove east for two hours.
ex.zh: 我們往東開了兩個小時。

ex.en: The window faces east.
ex.zh: 這扇窗戶朝東。

ease.zh: 容易、輕鬆（with ease：輕而易舉）

ex.en: She passed the exam with ease.
ex.zh: 她輕輕鬆鬆就通過了考試。

ex.en: The app is popular for its ease of use.
ex.zh: 這個 App 因為容易使用而大受歡迎。

ease.zh: at ease：自在、放鬆（ill at ease：不自在）

ex.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
ex.zh: 我和陌生人相處時很不自在。

ex.en: When I speak Chinese, I start to feel at ease.
ex.zh: 我說中文時開始覺得自在了。

ex.en: Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
ex.zh: 錢不能讓你快樂，但可以減輕你的痛苦。

ex.en: This medicine will ease the pain.
ex.zh: 這種藥可以減輕疼痛。

ex.en: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
ex.zh: 東歐的飲酒量比西歐高。

ex.en: The eastern part of the island is very quiet.
ex.zh: 這座島的東部非常安靜。

ex.en: She is interested in Eastern philosophy.
ex.zh: 她對東方哲學很有興趣。

ex.en: When the big earthquake occurred, I was just ten.
ex.zh: 大地震發生的時候，我才十歲。

ex.en: They had their houses destroyed by a strong earthquake.
ex.zh: 他們的房子被強烈地震震毀了。

ex.en: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.
ex.zh: 最近地震頻繁，讓我們很緊張。
